_about: WINWING URSA MINOR Fighter Flight Stick R (J5 base + F1-R grip). From SimAppPro2's own definition of this stick: the backlight is on the J5 base (part 47904 = 0xBB20, controller 0x20/0xbb), light 0, stored brightness in byte 0 of flash word 0xEC (0..255); the breathing light is byte 0 of word 0xF8 (0 = on, 1 = off).
name: URSA MINOR Fighter Stick R
